##### P1-GATE/quote-state-consistency — Quote-state consistency

| Gap ID | Priority | Status | Issue | PRD requires | Steps to reproduce (from PRD) | Direction to comply | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1-GATE/quote-state-consistency-G1 | P1 | Confirmed | The hourly quotes:check-expiry job queries quotes with status = 'quote', but the database stores the active status as 'sent' (the Eloquent accessor/mutator only translates model attributes, not raw where clauses). The query matches no rows, so quotes past expires_at are never flipped to expired and no expiry reminders or expired notices are sent. Other raw queries (dashboard counts, analytics, provider pricing) use the same 'quote' literal and are likewise out of step with stored data. | Scheduled expiry must move quotes to Expired so quote state is consistent across backend and provider/admin dashboards (plan Phase 1 exit gate, quote-state consistency; FR-004 quote expiry) | 1. Provider sends a quote with a short expiry (FR-004 quote creation). 2. Wait for expires_at to pass and the hourly job to run (FR-004 expiry). 3. Open the provider/admin quote list filtered by Expired; the quote still shows as active quote (FR-004 list filters). | Make the expiry job and every raw status query use the stored value ('sent') or a model scope, so expiry actually transitions state. | E-4137, E-4138, E-4139, E-4140, E-4141, E-4142, E-4143, E-4144 |
| P1-GATE/quote-state-consistency-G2 | P2 | Confirmed | The expiry status flip is gated behind the quote_notification setting: when notifications are disabled the command returns before flipping any quote to expired. The flip is also limited to quotes that expired within the last 7 days, so older stale quotes stay active. | Quote expiry is a state transition independent of whether notifications are sent (plan Phase 1 exit gate, quote-state consistency; FR-004 expiry) | 1. Admin turns off quote notifications in alert settings (FR-004 notification settings). 2. A sent quote passes expires_at. 3. The quote is never marked expired. | Always flip expired quotes regardless of notification settings and without the 7-day lower bound (use chunking instead); gate only the notifications. | E-4145, E-4146, E-4147 |
| P1-GATE/quote-state-consistency-G3 | P2 | Confirmed | There is no central transition map for Quote, Inquiry, or Booking. Illegal transitions are blocked only by per-endpoint guards (for example withdraw allows only sent quotes, accept checks canBeAccepted). Inquiry status is derived by updateStatusFromQuotes with a quote-status map keyed on values (scheduled, inprogress, aftercare) that Quote does not define as constants, and quote cancelled variants are not in the map. Direct model updates can set any status. | Inquiry, quote, and booking statuses follow one state machine and illegal transitions are rejected (plan line 60 Phase 1 exit gate) | 1. Provider withdraws a sent quote, then calls another status-changing quote endpoint that has no guard (FR-004 quote status lifecycle). 2. Observe the quote and its inquiry status after the call. 3. The status changes without any central allowed-transition check rejecting it (plan Phase 1 exit gate, quote-state consistency). | Define one allowed-transition table per entity and enforce it in the model or service layer used by all callers. | E-4148, E-4149, E-4150, E-4151 |

##### P1-GATE/scheduling-rules — Scheduling rules

| Gap ID | Priority | Status | Issue | PRD requires | Steps to reproduce (from PRD) | Direction to comply | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1-GATE/scheduling-rules-G1 | P1 | Confirmed | The v2 quote-option date-prices endpoint (POST /provider/quote/{quoteId}/options/{optionId}/date-prices) only checks format. It does not check that dates fall inside the inquiry's requested ranges, that slots do not overlap, that dates are not in the past, or that appointment_date lies within start_date..end_date. source_inquiry_date_range_id is not tied to the quote's inquiry. | Quote treatment dates must come from the patient's inquiry date ranges, with appointment dates inside a treatment date range and no overlaps, enforced server-side (plan line 26 'validate slot/overlap rules'; FR-004 PRD appointment_date mapping rule). | 1. Provider creates a quote with an option (re-read FR-005 v2 options section). 2. POST date-prices with appointment_date and start/end dates outside the inquiry ranges, or in the past, or overlapping each other. 3. The request is accepted and rows are replaced. | Apply the same within-inquiry-range, non-overlap, not-in-past and appointment-within-range checks to the option date-prices sync as the legacy create path. | E-4179, E-4180, E-4181, E-4182, E-4183 |
| P1-GATE/scheduling-rules-G2 | P1 | Confirmed | Editing an existing quote (POST /quote/{id}/update) accepts treatment_dates with only after_or_equal:today checks. It does not run the within-patient-ranges rule, the non-overlap check, or the appointment-within-range check that the create path (store) applies. A provider can move a quote's dates outside the patient's requested windows or make them overlap. | Quote dates must stay within the inquiry date ranges and not overlap, enforced server-side on every write path (plan line 26; FR-004 PRD appointment_date mapping rule). | 1. Provider opens an existing quote in status quote (re-read FR-004 quote edit workflow). 2. Update treatment_dates with a range outside the inquiry's requested ranges or overlapping another range. 3. The update is saved. | Reuse the create-path date validators (within patient ranges, non-overlap, appointment within range) in the update flow. | E-4184, E-4185, E-4186, E-4187, E-4188 |
| P1-GATE/scheduling-rules-G3 | P0 | Confirmed | POST /quote/schedule-quote loads the quote by ID with no ownership check against the caller's provider_id, and takes schedule_date and schedule_time with no validation against the quote's treatment dates, the accepted slot, or past dates. Any authenticated provider with edit-quote permission can create a schedule and flip another provider's accepted quote to scheduled. | Scheduling must follow the quote's accepted treatment dates/slots and be enforced server-side with provider isolation (plan lines 54, 65, 81; plan line 26). | 1. Provider B authenticates. 2. POST /quote/schedule-quote with quote_id of Provider A's accepted quote and any schedule_date. 3. Schedule is created under Provider B's provider_id and quote status becomes scheduled. | Require the quote to belong to the acting provider and validate the schedule date/time against the accepted appointment slot and treatment date range. | E-4189, E-4190, E-4191, E-4192 |

Whether that satisfies §A6 step 3 / REQ-009-022 (centralized audit logging) is a PRD interpretation call.

- E-1777 (FR-022/US1-G3): verifier downgraded (P2 Confirmed to P3 Confirmed): The two PRD examples work with the LIKE approach. The collation is utf8mb4_unicode_ci, which is accent- and case-insensitive, so 'Jose' matches 'José'. The CONCAT(first_name,' ',last_name) LIKE '%Mark P%' matches 'Mark Patterson'. What remains is that Rule 2 asks for full-text-index matching and the search does not use it. A FULLTEXT index ft_patients_name exists on first_name and last_name but nothing queries it, and the search has no MATCH AGAINST. Email matches anywhere (%mark@%) rather than as a prefix, which is a superset of the PRD's starts-with behaviour. The p95 latency was not measured.

### Refuted findings

- FR-009/B3-G3: refuted, The race exists (no lockForUpdate in acceptPublic or signupAndAccept), but the database still blocks a duplicate account. provider_users.email and provider_team_members.email are both unique. In a concurrent second signup, ProviderUser::create or the updateOrCreate insert hits the unique index, and the catch block rolls back and returns 500, so the B3 outcome (no duplicate account) holds. The only leftover issue is a generic 500 on the losing request instead of the already-used message, which is cosmetic and P3 at most. (main/hairline-backend/database/migrations/2024_01_31_154625_create_provider_users_table.php:17, main/hairline-backend/database/migrations/2025_01_15_000000_create_provider_team_members_table.php:20, main/hairline-backend/app/Http/Controllers/Provider/ProviderStaffInvitationController.php:1312-1322, main/hairline-backend/app/Http/Controllers/Provider/ProviderStaffInvitationController.php:1336-1346, main/hairline-backend/app/Http/Controllers/Provider/ProviderStaffInvitationController.php:1428-1448)
- FR-009/A4-G2: refuted, PRD A4 covers changing the Owner role through the provider UI, and the UI never sends a role through PUT /team/members/{id}. The member-detail screen changes roles through POST /team/members/{id}/change-role, which looks up roles on ProviderUser and blocks Owner targets with a 403. The only PUT caller sends status alone, and no provider-creation, invitation, or seeder path creates an Owner team-member row that the PUT role branch could reach, so the Owner role stays unchanged as A4 requires. ## Reconciliation notes

Duplicate and related gaps are kept as separate rows so each stays traceable to its unit; fix them once per root cause. Severities are left exactly as the checker and verifier settled them; the alignment list below is for whoever files the bugs.

### Method deviations

- Model: checkers for units 1-16 and verifiers through FR-009/B6-G3 ran on Opus; every checker and verifier launched after that ran on Sonnet (user request, 2026-10-21) to reduce token usage.
- Agent type: from unit 201 on, checkers and verifiers ran as the code-reviewer agent type with no MCP, ToolSearch or skill calls (user request); staging probes, where used, went through curl.
- Concurrency briefly reached 5 in flight (cap 4) while verifying FR-022/SCR-pr-02-inquiry-quote-management-G6 and FR-022/SCR-pr-02-inquiry-quote-management-G7; no effect on results.
- Verifier upgrade suggestions were never applied, per the rubric; the checker status stands for FR-005/E5-G4, FR-024/A2-G6, FR-031/US1-G5, FR-026/SCR-settings-management-dashboard-G6, FR-028/W3-G7, FR-028/US5-G4 and P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G6.

### Incidents

- Credential-folder reads were denied by the harness for the checkers of units 063, 128, 130, 131, 136, 166, 168, 239, 312, 322, 324 and 325, and a staging login probe was denied for unit 252. Findings for those units are static-only.
- Verifiers for FR-032/E5-G2 and P1-GATE/one-authoritative-api-G6 each created and removed a stray placeholder file in the session temp folder outside the repository; no repository files were touched.
- The verifier for P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G3 was stopped after its hand-back because it still held background work.

### Root-cause families

- Cross-provider access (provider ownership not enforced): FR-022/W1-G1, FR-022/A1-G6, FR-022/A2-G1, FR-022/US1-G1, FR-022/US3-G1 (admin patient list reachable with a provider token); FR-032/W1-G1, FR-032/A1-G1, FR-032/US1-G1 (profile and award overwrite); FR-022/SCR-pr-06-profile-settings-G1, FR-024/US3-G1, FR-024/US6-G4, FR-024/E2-G3 (packages); FR-015/A4-G3, FR-015/US2-G1 (provider documents); P1-GATE/live-rbac-G1, P1-GATE/provider-isolation-G1, P1-GATE/provider-isolation-G2, P1-GATE/provider-isolation-G3, P1-GATE/provider-isolation-G4, P1-GATE/provider-isolation-G5, P1-GATE/provider-isolation-G6, P1-GATE/provider-isolation-G7, P1-GATE/scheduling-rules-G3 (quotes, inquiries, schedules); FR-022/US5-G3 (patient offers).
- Pre-payment identity masking: P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G1, P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G2, P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G3, P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G4, P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G5, P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G6.

## Unresolved questions

- FR-009/W3-G6: The workload guard and reassignment cover only quotes where the member is clinician and active aftercare cases. Assigned inquiries and upcoming appointments are not counted or reassigned, so removal can proceed with that work orphaned.
- FR-009/A6-G3: Blocked removal attempts are not written to the audit trail. ProviderActivityLogger::log runs only after a successful delete; every rejection path just rolls back and returns.
- FR-009/B6-G3: Patient conversations are keyed to the provider organization (participant2_type provider with provider_id), not to an individual team member, so there is no per-member message routing to update; it is unclear whether B6 step 5 (and the "active threads of a member" trigger) requires introducing member-level thread ownership.
- FR-003/W1-G5: The created inquiry ID is a UUID, and HPID is only generated for the patient (HPID2508-0001, with a hyphen). No HPID-format inquiry ID is created at submission.
- FR-003/A1-G1: The backend has no inquiry draft persistence, resume endpoint, or 7-day draft expiry. Inquiry is created only by POST /inquiry/create-inquiry on full submission, and Inquiry statuses have no draft state. The only draft model and 7-day cleanup (RegistrationDraft, drafts:cleanup-expired) belong to patient registration, not inquiries. The system technical spec places the draft client-side (AsyncStorage key draft_inquiry), and that code is in main/hairline-app/, which this review may not open.
- FR-003/A2-G2: The backend has no persistence for incomplete (draft) inquiries: the inquiry row is created only by a full submit (store) that validates the head scan and questionnaire, and there is no draft status, draft table, save-draft or resume endpoint. The registration_drafts table and cleanup command cover registration only. If drafts live only on the mobile client, the backend cannot prompt or resume across devices; the app is out of scope so this cannot be settled.
- FR-003/A2-G3: Patient-facing status never yields 'incomplete' or 'pending': the status set is requested/offers/accepted/scheduled/confirmed/in_progress/completed/cancelled, and one-active-inquiry in store counts any non-cancelled, non-completed inquiry as active, returning 'cancel it before submitting a new one' instead of a continue/resume option.
- FR-003/W2-G3: No FR-037 exclusive-provider routing exists: no exclusive/assigned-provider field or branch in distribution, and no decline-fallback that removes exclusivity and redistributes once.
- FR-003/W2-G4: Cap selection takes manual providers first then auto-matched in DB order; there is no ranking by matching rules, and manual selections beyond 10 are truncated by take(10) (patient max is 5, so low risk). Records are also created only for the capped set, fine.
- FR-003/W2-G7: HPID format generated as HPIDYYMM-NNNN (with hyphen), while PRD shows HPID2501001 without hyphen; also generated at patient level, not per inquiry. The PRD example itself is ambiguous (HPID+25+01+0001 vs example HPID2501001).
- FR-003/W3-G5: Provider list is limited to inquiry_providers rows with selected_quote_id null; it does not exclude cancelled/expired inquiries or check the provider's own participation state, and the list lacks an Age/Concern/Alerts tied pagination count (alert filter applied after fetch in memory). Behavior is functional but unbounded (loads all rows then paginates in PHP).
- FR-003/W3-G6: No provider action found for 'Need clarification' (request clarification via admin, inquiry stays in Inquiry stage); only generic messaging may cover it. PRD does not name the mechanism.
- FR-003/C1-G1: No inquiry-scoped clarification request exists. The provider inquiry detail page has no ask-for-clarification action, and the only provider-to-admin channel is the generic support case (POST /provider/support-cases, subject/category/message/priority). It cannot reference an inquiry, so admin does not see which inquiry needs clarification.
- FR-003/C1-G2: A provider invited to a patient's inquiry can open a direct conversation with that patient (startPatientConversation). The check only needs an inquiry_providers row, with no payment or acceptance gate. This lets the provider ask the patient for clarification directly, not through admin.
- FR-003/W5-E1-G1: Cancelling an inquiry sends no confirmation notification to the patient; InquiryController::cancel only notifies providers (QuoteCancelledNotification and InquiryCancelledNotification) and returns the JSON success response.
- FR-003/US3-G5: Anonymization also leaves the raw patient_id UUID on the root inquiry object (selected and not unset), and gender/age stay visible. The PRD allows only the HPID pseudonymous ID as a visible identifier; patient_info.id also carries the patient UUID.
- FR-003/E1-G2: The 5-file cap is applied separately to photos (max 5) and additional_files (max 5), so up to 10 evidence files pass; the head scan has its own separate cap of 5.
- FR-003/E3-G2: Detail-completeness validation is driven by hard-coded config keys and name conventions. It does not use the FR-025 active questionnaire set's is_required or detail_prompt, and any key sent with a Yes value is checked.
- FR-003/E7-G1: No exclusive (FR-037 monitoring-conversion) routing exists in the backend: no restriction field, no exclusive-provider logic, no decline-triggered redistribution. The edge case (expiry without decline leaves exclusive routing on its expiry path) therefore cannot occur or be observed.
- FR-003/E7-G2: No scheduled job auto-expires inquiries when distribution_expires_at passes; the field is only set and admin-overridden in the controller. Only inquiry:check-sla (admin SLA notification) and quote expiry run on a schedule, so the 'existing expiry rules' the PRD refers to are not enforced on a timer.
- FR-004/A4-G2: The quote create path (QuotesController::store) still creates new Package and PackageItem rows (is_custom=true, 'Custom Package') whenever the submitted price, items, or travel fields differ from the selected package. It also creates a 'Travel Package' row when no package is chosen. These are rows in the packages table, not only quote-local snapshots. List and treatment endpoints filter is_custom=false, so the visible library is unchanged.
- FR-004/A4-G3: The option store endpoint takes the snapshot fields (name, description, standard price, travel flags) as client-supplied input. It does not copy them server-side from the provider's package at source_package_id and source_package_version. It only checks that the package ID exists, not that it belongs to the provider or is active. The PRD does not say whether the server or the client builds the snapshot.
- FR-005/A7-G5: Hold duration is hard-coded to 48 hours in two places and not read from an FR-026 setting.
- FR-022/US2-G1: The admin provider list has no Location/country filter in the UI. The backend index accepts country_id and city_id, but ProviderFilter offers only status, commission type, featured and date range.
- FR-022/US2-G2: No Approve action exists on provider details or in the status API. Statuses are only active, suspended and deactivated, and the update-status request validates only those three. The UI offers only Suspend and Activate.
- FR-022/US5-G1: No patient endpoint lists or sorts/filters subquotes (QuoteOption + QuoteOptionDatePrice) across parent quotes. GET /quote/get-quotes (QuotesController::index) returns parent quotes with only a filter=expired/active/all param and no sort or date-range params. GET /quote/get-patient-single-quote returns options and date_prices for one quote only.
- FR-022/US5-G3: getAllOffersByInquiry loads the inquiry with findOrFail and no patient ownership check, so any authenticated caller can read another patient's offers by inquiry_id (also getQuotesByInquiry has no ownership check). The sort/filter endpoint the PRD relies on lacks tenant isolation.
- FR-022/SCR-pr-01-provider-team-G5: The Role Compatibility context filter (reassignment workflows only) was not found in the list endpoint or the Team UI. A reassign-workload endpoint exists, but whether it applies the eligibility filter was not verified.
- FR-032/A2-G3: Deletion is deferred. The award is removed from the public profile only after the provider saves the whole profile (is_deleted flag sent on save). The PRD implies the removal takes effect on confirmation.
- FR-032/A5-G5: In-app (database) notification rows are always written before any preference check, even when all types are disabled; the preference only gates email and push. Per the PRD the provider should receive no notifications, so it is unclear whether in-app notices are meant to be suppressed.
- FR-032/US2-G4: S-03 sync is a placeholder that only logs; no sync job or HTTP call. Enforcement happens at send time by reading the table, so behavior works but the 'updates S-03 within 1 minute' step is stubbed.
- FR-024/W1-G4: Description is required on create, and the form has no markdown preview or WYSIWYG editor, no 30-second auto-save draft, and no resumable video upload. The 'at least one of description, video or images' rule is not implemented as written.
- FR-024/US1-G2: Create only rejects ProviderUser. The route group accepts auth:provider,api, so any other authenticated api-guard user (not verified as admin/super-admin) can create a treatment. isAdminUser exists but is not used here.
- FR-024/E3-G3: Server rule is skipped when min is empty/0 (truthy check), and the client InputNumber min equals the min count, so equal values pass the client and are only rejected by the server. A second route (POST update-treatment) accepts max equal to min, but the provider pricing UI does not call it.
- FR-015/W1-G1: The admin wizard posts to the legacy POST /provider/create-provider (ProviderController::createProviderProfile), not to the newer admin/provider-management/providers endpoint, so the stricter StoreProviderRequest and the activation-token logic in ProviderManagementController::store are not the path the dashboard uses. The two creation paths differ in validation, storage and audit behavior.
- FR-015/A1-G4: Success and generic responses all use 'If an account exists with this email, you will receive an activation email shortly.' The PRD gives two different texts: step 9 success message with spam hint and 24-hour expiry, and a generic message 'an activation link will be sent'. The code matches neither exactly and omits the spam-folder and 24-hour text.
- FR-015/A6-G7: Same-status request (active to active) returns success as a no-op through the status endpoint, and the response does not return suspension details or unresolved support count needed by Screen 5; no endpoint found for the modal's display-only data (latest suspension event, unresolved support items).
- FR-015/E9-G3: The seat-limit change reason is optional (justification nullable, label 'optional'), whereas REQ-015-025 asks for a 10-500 character reason on Tab 1 saves. It is unclear whether the dedicated seat modal falls under that rule.
- FR-015/E10-G3: Self-service resend looks up ProviderUser by email with first(), without checking that the provider is not Deactivated. Because Deactivated providers' emails are freed for reuse, a stale record could be picked.
- FR-015/E12-G2: Only not-yet-activated accounts reach the per-email 3/hour check and can get a 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED response. Activated or unknown emails never get 429, so the 4th request reveals a pending-activation account, a small enumeration side channel against the PRD intent.
- FR-031/A1-G2: Resend writes no audit trail entry. The resend() method only updates the token and sends the notification, with no RolePermissionAuditLog record. The PRD requires administrative actions to be logged.
- FR-025/W4-G4: No admin notification is sent when the Inquiry designation is removed or the active set is archived. Only the catalog banner (rendered while viewing the page) reflects the unconfigured state; deactivate and archive write audit logs only.
- FR-026/A4-G3: The settings write routes (POST, PUT, DELETE, reorder) are guarded only by auth:api. No Settings Manager or Settings Viewer role or permission check was found, so any admin-guard account can change cancellation reasons.
- FR-026/B2-G2: No server-side record of propagation delay exists (no log or metric tying a late poll to a settings change); only unrelated 'propagation window' comments appear. Server cannot see a client that failed to poll.
- FR-026/US1-G2: The editor sends and stores an apply_to flag (patient, provider, admin) that the PRD does not mention. Login in AuthController never reads it, so unchecking a role has no effect and the limits always apply to patient and provider login.
- FR-026/US2-G2: Preview in the dashboard is a live panel using client-side sample code 123456 and a client-side sanitizer; there is no explicit Preview button, and the backend preview endpoint (sample code 847291) is not called by the dashboard. Also the Save button always versions both templates together, even if only one changed.
- FR-026/US3-G4: Flag upload goes through the generic /files/upload (any file type up to 10MB, local public disk) rather than a flag-specific validated image upload, and the form falls back to a base64 preview as flag_url if the upload response shape is unexpected.
- FR-026/US4-G5: No discovery-question analytics report exists. Patient selections are saved to questionnaires.discovery, but no analytics or report code reads them.
- FR-026/E4-G1: Version-history UI always masks sensitive values (as bullet characters) and has no Show control or permission-gated unmask; the frontend comment says the reveal permission was removed under FR-031. The PRD still requires admins with View Sensitive Settings to click Show. The Show requirement is therefore unmet, but the code deliberately removed it, so the PRD sources conflict.
- FR-028/W1-G7: A second, parallel regional-groups API (RegionalGroupController, table regional_groups) exists with different rules: change_reason optional on create, no cross-group country uniqueness check, hard delete. The dashboard and patient endpoint use location-preferences. It is unclear which store is authoritative.
- FR-028/B3-G3: The parallel RegionalGroupController (routes regional-groups) accepts change_reason as nullable on store, while update and destroy require 10-500 chars with the PRD message. The frontend grouping modal uses location-preferences, not this route, so it is unclear which API is authoritative.
- FR-028/W2-G5: Pricing write routes sit in an auth:provider,api group with no role or permission middleware; the controller only checks that an api-guard (admin) user exists, so any admin can change prices, not only the System Configuration role. Mapping of that role to FR-031 is not resolved here.
- FR-028/W3-G5: The API requires the client to send patient_country and patient_currency. The server does not read the patient's profile location or currency, and has no IP geolocation fallback.
- FR-028/W3-G7: The default order when no grouping matches is provider count descending, not geographic proximity to the patient. Providers are counted by country only, with no status or active filter. The configured location display cap (5-20) is not applied.
- FR-028/US4-G3: The update endpoint checks only that an api-guard user is logged in. It does not check the System Configuration role from REQ-028-013. This may be handled by a global admin policy that was not found in this unit.
- FR-028/E6-G3: The 'conversion unavailable' condition is never evaluated: the Priority 3 branch returns any active currency labelled '(approx. <patient currency>)' without consulting FR-029 rates (the code comments call it a placeholder), so a price is shown even when no rate exists.
- P1-GATE/pre-payment-identity-privacy-G6: Inquiry detail (GET /api/inquiry/get-single-inquiry) correctly masks name, email and phone, but its masked name shows the full first name plus the last initial. Head-scan images, uploaded photos and original file names are returned unmasked before payment, and there is no check that the inquiry was distributed to the calling provider.
- Run method note: check points were not folded one by one into each unit. Each checker read the unit's primary PRD excerpt, the folded screen-spec ranges, and the FR's business-rule ranges, and applied only the rules that govern its unit (disclosed at the frozen-list approval). Briefs and unit excerpts were passed to subagents as scratchpad files rather than inline prompt text; the content is identical to the skill's prompt template.
- Run method note: the harness task tracker was not available in this session, so the live work queue was kept in a session scratchpad state folder; the Summary table remains the resume checkpoint.
- Needs decision (verifier disagreement): reachability of legacy POST actions/action-quote accepted branch. Verifier FR-004/A7-G2 judged it patient-reachable (kept P3); verifier FR-004/A8-G2 judged it unreachable because the route is under auth:provider while the branch requires the inquiry patient (downgraded to P3 latent). Both gaps end at P3; confirm at runtime whether the route is registered for patients elsewhere (routes/api.php:2146, 2264).
- Needs decision (FR-004/A10-G2 vs FR-004/US2-G5): the two provider-suspension paths behave differently. Admin ProviderManagementController revokes provider-user tokens on suspend/deactivate (ProviderManagementController.php:660-664), but legacy ProviderController::suspend has token revocation commented out (ProviderController.php:5238-5248). Whether the legacy path is still reachable decides how exposed the missing provider-Active check is on quote create and edit; FR-004/A10-G2 was downgraded to P2, while FR-004/US2-G5 stays at P2.
- FR-022/US2-G1 Needs decision: FR-022 PRD self-conflict, US2 sc.2 Location filter vs REQ-022-004 / FR-015 Screen 1 filter list (no Location).
- FR-022/US2-G2 Needs decision: FR-022 US2 sc.5 'Approve' action vs FR-015 v1.1 removal of approve/reject workflow (activation via email link).
- FR-022/US5-G1 Needs decision: is subquote sort/filter for FR-005 Screen 1 server-side or client-side? Backend lacks it; app not reviewed.
- FR-022/US5-G3 Needs decision (security, flag prominently): GET /inquiry/get-all-offers has a real IDOR, inquiry loaded without patient ownership check. Verifier says FR-022 REQs do not cover own-data isolation; decide whether to file as P0 security bug outside FR-022.
